name: Header opens keyboard shortcuts cheat sheet and canvas resize modal
description: Verify opening and closing the shortcuts guide modal and canvas dimension resizer dialog.

planSteps.description: Click the Guide button in the top header (with title 'Atelier Guide, Diagnostics & Shortcuts (?)')
Verify the shortcuts modal opens displaying keyboard shortcuts for Tools, Canvas, and Animation
Click the Close button on the shortcuts modal
Verify the shortcuts modal is dismissed
Click the canvas dimension button 32x32 in the top header
Verify the Canvas Resize modal opens displaying width and height controls and preset dimension options
